proves.claim: With items.barRulesAtAdd on, a lane bar deleting or renaming a file approved must rows gate on is refused SPEC_GATE_ROW naming the row ids.

cli.io-item-bar-spec.refuses-a-removed-g.why: Without it a lane builder claims a bar that pre-commit refuses and the spec cannot be edited from the lane, so the claim is wasted.

proves.claim: The SPEC_GATE_ROW refusal names the lane piece, then the coordinator piece filed after it with --split-coordinator.

cli.io-item-bar-spec.next-step-is-the-sp.why: Without it the filer gets a refusal with no way forward.

proves.claim: With the setting off, for a coordinator or person filer, or for a criterion that only reads the file or deletes a file no approved must row names, the bar is accepted.

cli.io-item-bar-spec.accepts-off-reads-a.why: Without it the rule would block bars it was never meant to refuse.
